newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IBCA re-affirms Investec Bank ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA re-affirms Investec Bank ratings.

text.p: International rating agency IBCA on Tuesday re-affirmed the short-term A1 domestic and long-term A+ ratings of Investec Bank Ltd.
The agency said in a statement it also re-affirmed the bank's international individual B and legal 4T ratings.

It said the international "B" individual rating indicated a bank with a sound risk profile without any significant problems and was on a par with other internationally rated South African banks such as Standard Bank investment Corp Ltd and First National Bank Holdings Ltd.
In domestic terms, Investec Bank had the highest capacity for timely repayment in the short-term and a low expectation of investment risk in the long-term.
